sector: PET recycling (recycled polyester fibre, food-grade rPET resin, chemically recycled resin)
headline: Revenue grew at a 25.3% CAGR over FY24-FY26 with positive operating cash flow each year, but PAT was flat (Rs 211.3 m to Rs 224.9 m) and ROCE stayed near 10%; the Rs 90.10 reference price is about 69x FY26 EPS, in line with the single listed peer.
red_flags: Revenue CAGR 25.3% FY24-26; PAT flat at Rs 211.3 m / 205.7 m / 224.9 m (p. 72)
Operating cash flow positive every year; cumulative CFO/PAT 201%, about 108% after interest (p. 73)
ROCE 10.28% and EBITDA margin 10.86% FY26; net debt / EBITDA 3.40x, down from 5.25x (p. 122)
Capacity utilisation 70% in FY26 on 141,000 MTPA; 180,360 MTPA at Aug-2026 (pp. 24, 225)
Revaluation reserve Rs 614.81 m = 22.5% of total equity; issuer net worth excludes it (p. 397)
Customer and supplier concentration not disclosed; audit trail not enabled at database level (pp. 43-45, 244)
reference_note: Rs 90.10 = Sep-2025 preferential issue at Rs 901 per Rs 10 share, adjusted for the 4:1 bonus and 1:2 split (pp. 125-127). It is a reference point, not a price band.

strengths: Second largest Indian PET recycler by installed capacity, 180,360 MTPA at Aug-2026; source: issuer-commissioned report (p. 220)
Only Indian player with mechanical and chemical recycling; food-grade resin approved by two global beverage firms (pp. 224, 226)
CFO positive each year: 156.84 / 315.32 / 820.93 Rs m (p. 73)
Net debt / EBITDA 5.25x to 3.40x over FY24-26 (p. 122)
Litigation materiality threshold of Rs 10.70 m is the lowest of three tests (p. 384)
weaknesses: PAT flat: Rs 211.32 m FY24 vs Rs 224.92 m FY26 (p. 72)
RPSF still 55.12% of revenue; Chemically Recycled Resins revenue fell 23.3% in FY26 (p. 223)
Revenue per tonne fell 2.4% in FY26 while volume rose 18.4% (pp. 122, 72)
Audit trail not enabled at database level, FY26 (p. 43)
opportunities: Mandatory recycled content in rigid packaging of 30% / 40% / 50% / 60% for FY26-FY29 (p. 222)
Indian food-grade rPET resin volume 300.0 KT in FY26 to 2,210.7 KT by FY31, issuer-commissioned estimate (p. 187)
Food-grade capacity raised to 56,160 MTPA in Aug-2026; FY26 utilisation of this line was 52.47% (pp. 24, 227)
Rs 3,200 m debt repayment against Rs 3,493.95 m outstanding on listed loans (p. 113)
threats: Corporate guarantees of Rs 1,155.20 m for the subsidiary's loans (p. 74)
Raw material (PET waste) has no long-term supply contracts (p. 228)
Fire at the plant on 04-Dec-2025; insurance claim under assessment (p. 26)
Ganesha Ecosphere, a larger listed rival, runs 64,500 TPA of food-grade capacity (p. 188)
Imports were 11.02% of FY26 COGS, up from 1.86% (p. 244)

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -79.9% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
RED: terminal ROIC below WACC - growth destroys value
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 406.6 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.
